# Image to Video

Image to video: animate a photo or picture from your MegaScenes library into a short clip with the motion and camera move you describe, generated in a few minutes.

## What it does
Pick a picture from your MegaScenes library (upload one in the Studio, or make one with the Image plugin), describe the motion, and get a short clip. Works well for product shots, portraits, landscapes and logos.

**How the files are made:** each clip is generated by a video model that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Starts from a picture in your MegaScenes library: upload one in the Studio, or make one first.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install image-to-video@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Image to Video talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/animate/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each clip uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- Clips take one to a few minutes: Claude checks on progress, and the clip plays in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps (a link in Claude Code).

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_animation_models` | Models for animations with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_animation_cost` | Exact price of one animation before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_animation` | Starts one animation in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_animation` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `list_my_images` | Your uploads and images made here, to pick the one to start from. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Animate the lighthouse image with waves crashing and a slow push in"
- "Make the logo glow and rotate gently for an intro"
- "Add drifting fog and moving clouds to the forest picture"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the clip (the picture you pick from your library and the motion you describe) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
